tickets.title: Typed job contracts and one atomic write helper
tickets.what: Proposal docs/neon-proposal/02-decompose-monoliths-and-ts-bins.md S1 (:621): job-contracts.ts, job-io.ts, paths.ts replace the scattered untyped STATUS.json/.tmp+rename writes. Runs after build-dedup 01 (paths move to src/mcp). Zero behaviour change.

acceptance.text: Typed MCP job-file writers use shared names and retain the existing atomic-fs writes; exclusive markers and recoverable worker-tree staging keep their protocols.
Disk JSON fields unchanged; npm test passes

comments.author: legacy
comments.text: build on primitives/01 (atomic-fs) instead of adding job-io's second atomic layer; S1 keeps only the typed contracts and paths.

tickets.title: Worker and runtime bins become TypeScript

comments.author: legacy
comments.text: The current package has 17 bins. The 13 moved entries include the reloadable watch runtime; `hud-mcp`, `surface`, `generation` and `agy-events` remain source-only for pre-build startup or hook delivery.
